home_lead: Every dive, every setting, every zone, up to the 3D model of the submerged lock.
home_alt: Render of the 3D model of zone 12 seen from the west, sunlight rays falling through the water: masonry pier, spillway sluice gates and walkway, covered in zebra mussels
home_about: Lock 21 has been underwater since 1958, at Dickinson Landing, one of the Lost Villages of the St. Lawrence. I set out to digitize the whole structure in 3D, zone by zone, with photogrammetry. This site is the field notebook: it shows the lock to people who don't dive, helps divers plan their dives, and documents the method so others can do it elsewhere.
home_startSub: Three ways in, depending on what brings you here.
model_model1: Lock 21 at Dickinson Landing, under the St. Lawrence since 1958, surveyed zone by zone with underwater photogrammetry. Every zone is assembled into a single model; the zones not yet digitised are added dive after dive. The ground around is modelled, not surveyed.
